question: The new release is failing. Roll back or ship a hotfix?
context: Policy P5 requires an error rate above 2% to be mitigated within 15 minutes of detection.

evidence.text: Monitoring shows a 4% error rate since the release, detected just now.
Rolling back takes five minutes. Writes queued in the last three minutes are lost unless the queue is drained first, which takes one minute.
Engineers estimate a hotfix needs 40 minutes including review.

fields.name: time_to_fix
fields.description: time until the error rate is back under 2%

fields.name: drain
fields.description: is the write queue drained before rollback
